manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.title: 26.4. Fmod Profiler | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-profiler.html.summary: 26.4. Fmod Profiler Profiler 是 FMOD Studio 中的一个实用工具，可实时查看 Unity 引擎中的音频事件、内存占用及 CPU 占用等信息。若要在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中连接 Unity 引擎，请遵循以下步骤： The Profiler is a utility in FMOD Studio that lets you watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time. To connect the Unity engine to the FMOD Studio Profiler, follow these steps. 打开 FMOD Studio：启动 FMOD Studio 并打开音频项目。 Open FMOD Studio: launch FMOD Studio and open your audio project. 打开 Profiler：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Profiler"。这将打开 Profiler 窗口。 Open the Profiler: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and then select "Profiler". This opens the Profiler window. 启动 Unity：确保 Unity 项目已打开，并在 Unity 中加载包含 FMOD 插件的场景。 Start Unity: make sure the Unity project is open and load the scene that contains the FMOD plugin. 设置连接：回到 Unity，点击顶部菜单栏中的 "FMOD"，然后选择 "Edit Settings"。在 Inspector 窗口中，展开 "Live Update" 部分，并勾选 "Enable Live Update"。确保 "Live Update Port" 与 FMOD Studio Profiler 中的端口设置相匹配（默认为 9264）。 Set up the connection: back in Unity, click "FMOD" in the top menu bar and select "Edit Settings". In the Inspector window, expand the "Live Update" section and tick "Enable Live Update". Make sure "Live Update Port" matches the port configured in the FMOD Studio Profiler (9264 by default). 激活实时更新：在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，点击 "Live Update" 按钮，确保其处于激活状态。激活后，按钮背景颜色应变为绿色。这将允许 FMOD Studio 与 Unity 引擎实时同步音频数据。 Activate live update: in the Profiler window of FMOD Studio, click the "Live Update" button and make sure it is active. Once active, the background of the button turns green. This lets FMOD Studio synchronize audio data with the Unity engine in real time. 连接 Profiler：现在，回到 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口。点击圆形的录制按钮。 Connect the Profiler: now go back to the Profiler window of FMOD Studio and click the round record button. 开始调试：现在，可以在 Unity 中运行场景。在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，可以实时查看 Unity 引擎中的音频事件、内存占用及 CPU 占用等信息，从而更好地分析和调试音量问题。 Start debugging: you can now run your scene in Unity. In the Profiler window of FMOD Studio you can watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time, which makes it easier to analyze and debug volume problems. 检查音效 Checking the Audio 在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中，可以通过以下方法对比并诊断音量问题： In the FMOD Studio Profiler you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the following ways. 检查事件的实时音量：在 Profiler 窗口的左侧栏中，可以查看正在播放的音频事件。选中其中一个事件，然后在右侧栏中查看该事件的实时音量数据。观察音量数据，检查是否存在异常波动或数值过低的情况。 Check the real-time volume of an event: the left panel of the Profiler window lists the audio events that are playing. Select one of them and the right panel shows its real-time volume data. Watch that data and check whether it fluctuates abnormally or is too low. 使用 Mixer 查看音量：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Mixer"。这将打开 Mixer 窗口。在 Mixer 中，可以查看不同总线的音量及其相互关系。请注意，如果 Profiler 中的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity，Mixer 也会显示实时音量数据。检查各个总线的音量，以确保其未低于预期值。 Use the Mixer to inspect volume: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and select "Mixer" to open the Mixer window. There you can see the volume of the different buses and how they relate to each other. Note that when "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, the Mixer also shows real-time volume data. Check the volume of each bus to make sure none of them is lower than expected. 监听音频：在 Profiler 的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity 时，可以实时收听 Unity 中播放的音频。这样可以直接比较 FMOD Studio 和 Unity 中的音频效果，并判断音量是否存在问题。 Listen to the audio: while "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, you can listen to the audio playing in Unity in real time. This lets you compare the result in FMOD Studio with the result in Unity directly and judge whether there is a volume problem. 记录并分析：在 Profiler 窗口中，可以点击 "Record" 按钮开始录制音频性能数据。录制完成后，可以详细分析音量、CPU 占用及内存占用等数据，以找出潜在问题。 Record and analyze: in the Profiler window you can click the "Record" button to start recording audio performance data. When the recording is finished you can analyze volume, CPU usage and memory usage in detail to find where the problem may be. 对比预期效果：如果有音频效果的预期结果（例如之前的录音或参考音频），可以将实时播放的音频与预期结果进行对比。这有助于判断音量是否有问题。 Compare against the expected result: if you have an expected result for the audio (for example an earlier recording or a reference track), you can compare the audio playing in real time against it. This helps you judge whether the volume is wrong. 通过上述方法，可以在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中对比并诊断音量问题。请注意，音量问题可能源于 FMOD 项目设置、音频文件的初始音量、Unity 中的音量设置等多种原因。在诊断问题时，请全面检查各个方面的设置。 With these methods you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the FMOD Studio Profiler. Keep in mind that a volume problem can come from many places: the FMOD project settings, the initial volume of the audio file, the volume settings in Unity, and so on. When diagnosing, check the settings on every side.

manual/mod/fmod-sound-debugging.html.title: 26.5. Fmod Sound Debugging Tool Fmod 音效调试工具 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/fmod-sound-debugging.html.summary: 26.5. Fmod Sound Debugging Tool Fmod 音效调试工具 在 Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/Tools/RuntimeDebugger/FmodPlayground.unity 目录下， 提供了一个 Fmod 音效调试场景，该环境与游戏真实环境逻辑保持一致。可用于快速调试不同距离下的 Fmod 音效。 The path above holds a scene for debugging Fmod audio. Its logic is kept consistent with the real in-game environment, so you can quickly test how an Fmod sound behaves at different distances. Firing Sound Debugging 开火音效调试 找到 FmodSoundDebugger 物体，选择 Bullet Sound，拖入自己的开火音效，然后点击运行。 Find the FmodSoundDebugger object, select Bullet Sound, drag in your own firing sound, and then click Play. 随后即可听到开火音效的循环播放。进入 Scene 窗口拖动该物体以改变其距离（例如 Z 值），即可测试不同距离下的音效强度。 You will then hear the firing sound play on a loop. Go into the Scene window and drag this object to change its distance — its z value, for example — to test how loud the sound is at different distances.

manual/mod/get-started.html.summary: 项目初始化 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run get-started 1. 下载并解压 SDK 打开 装甲纷争模组 SDK 发行页，展开 Assets，下载名称为 Panzer-War-Mod-SDK-sdk-*.zip 的发行包。它包含可用的 DLL 和本地依赖。用压缩工具选择全部解压，保留 UnityProject 和同级 Packages。单独复制工程目录会使引用失效。已有工程可从下一步开始，也可以参照 GameHub 环境配置 创建工程。 2. 确认工程根目录和版本 打开 UnityProject，确认包含 Assets/、Packages/manifest.json 和 ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt。按 Unity 引擎版本要求 安装工程声明的版本。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.Directory/Exists", "args": [ "Assets" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/Exists", "args": [ "Packages/manifest.json" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/ReadAllText", "args": [ "ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "m_EditorVersion: 2022.3.62f2" } } ] 3. 在 Unity Hub 打开工程 在 Unity Hub 的 Projects → Add → Add project from disk 中选择 UnityProject。选到正确目录时，应能看到本教程第 2 节列出的三个位置。 在项目列表打开刚添加的工程。如果 Hub 提示缺少版本，先安装 ProjectVersion.txt 声明的编辑器，再重新打开。第一次打开需要导入包和编译。 等进度结束后查看 Console。编译通过时，顶部会出现 Framework - 框架 菜单。找不到菜单时，先确认选择的是内层 UnityProject，再检查相邻的 Packages 是否完整解压。 接着按需设置 Steam 游戏目录，或开始从零制作第一辆坦克。

manual/mod/jenkins-setup.html.title: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/jenkins-setup.html.summary: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration 1. 安装 Jenkins：Installing Jenkins Jenkins 是一款开源的自动化构建工具，你需要先安装 Jenkins。你可以从 Jenkins 的官方网站 https://www.jenkins.io/download/ 下载适合你系统的 Jenkins 安装包，并按照安装向导完成安装。安装成功后，你可以在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins。 Jenkins is an open source automation build tool, and you need to install it first. You can download the Jenkins installer for your system from the Jenkins official website https://www.jenkins.io/download/ and install it by following the setup wizard. After a successful installation you can reach Jenkins by entering http://localhost:8080/ in your browser. 面向小白的详细的安装教程：Step-by-step Installation Guide for Beginners 在你的服务器或本地计算机上打开浏览器，并访问 Jenkins 官方网站：https://www.jenkins.io/download/。 On your server or local computer, open a browser and go to the Jenkins official website. 在 Jenkins 下载页面上，你可以看到针对不同操作系统的 Jenkins 安装包。请选择适合你操作系统的下载链接，例如 Windows 系统可选择 Windows MSI 安装包。 On the Jenkins download page you can see installers for the different operating systems. Pick the download link for your own operating system, for example the Windows MSI installer on Windows. 下载完成后，双击安装包以启动安装向导。根据向导提示，选择安装目录、安装类型等设置。默认情况下，Jenkins 将安装在 C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins 目录下。 When the download has finished, double click the installer to open the setup wizard. Follow the prompts to choose the install directory, the install type and other settings. By default Jenkins is installed into C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins. 在安装过程中，你需要选择 Jenkins 的运行环境。你可以选择将 Jenkins 安装为 Windows 服务，或作为普通的 Windows 程序运行。在大多数情况下，我们建议将其安装为 Windows 服务，以便在系统重启后自动启动 Jenkins。 During the installation you need to choose how Jenkins runs. You can install Jenkins as a Windows service or run it as an ordinary Windows program. In most cases we recommend installing it as a Windows service, so that Jenkins starts automatically after the system reboots. 安装完成后，Jenkins 将启动并监听默认的 HTTP 端口 8080。你可以在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins 的 Web 界面。如果你已将 Jenkins 安装为 Windows 服务，它将在后台自动运行，并且你可以在 Windows 服务列表中找到它，以便在需要时手动启动、停止或重启 Jenkins。 After the installation Jenkins starts and listens on the default HTTP port 8080. You can enter http://localhost:8080/ in your browser to open the Jenkins web interface. If you installed Jenkins as a Windows service it runs in the background automatically, and you can find it in the Windows service list to start, stop or restart it manually when needed. 首次启动 Jenkins 时，你需要输入管理员账户的用户名和密码。随后 Jenkins 会要求你选择要安装的插件，你可以选择推荐插件或手动选择所需插件。插件安装需要一些时间，请耐心等待。 The first time Jenkins starts you need to enter the user name and password of the administrator account. Jenkins then asks you to choose which plugins to install; you can take the recommended plugins or select the ones you need manually. Installing the plugins takes a while, so please be patient. 安装完成后，你将看到 Jenkins 的主界面。至此，Jenkins 已成功安装，你可以开始使用它来构建项目。 Once this is done you will see the Jenkins main interface. Jenkins is now installed successfully and you can start using it to build your projects. 2. 安装 Unity3D：Installing Unity3D 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目之前，需要在 Jenkins 服务器上安装 Unity3D。请确保安装了适合你项目的 Unity3D 版本。 Before you can build a Unity3D project in Jenkins, Unity3D has to be installed on the Jenkins server. Make sure the Unity3D version you install is the one your project needs. Unity Engine Requirement Unity 引擎版本要求 3. 安装 Unity3D 插件：Installing the Unity3D Plugin 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目需要安装 Unity3D 插件。打开 Jenkins，进入“插件管理”页面，搜索“Unity3D”并安装。安装成功后，你需要重启 Jenkins。 Building a Unity3D project in Jenkins requires the Unity3D plugin. Open Jenkins, go to the plugin management page, search for "Unity3D" and install it. After a successful installation you need to restart Jenkins. 4. 配置 Jenkins 项目：Configuring the Jenkins Project 进入 Jenkins 项目的“配置”页面，并设置 Unity3D 安装目录路径。 Go to the configuration page of the Jenkins project and set the path of the Unity3D installation directory there. 5. 创建 Jenkins 项目：Creating a Jenkins Project 在 Jenkins 中创建一个新项目。进入 Jenkins 主页，点击“新建项目”按钮，选择“自由风格软件项目”并输入项目名称。 Create a new project in Jenkins. Go to the Jenkins home page, click the new project button, choose the freestyle software project type and enter a project name. 增加一个构建步骤： Add a build step. 选择刚刚配置的 Unity，然后设置如下打包命令： Select the Unity installation you just configured, then set the following build command. -projectPath <项目路径> -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config <配置文件路径>

class("ChargedShot") function ChargedShot:OnVehicleReady(vehicle) local weapon = WeaponAPI.GetWeapon(vehicle, 0) if weapon == nil or self.chargeTime <= 0 then self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end self.weapon = weapon self.damage = weapon.DamageBuffedCoff self.charge = 0 self.buff = BuffAPI.CreateValueBuff("Charged Shot", false, 0) self.damage:AddBuff(self.buff) WeaponAPI.OnFired(self.script, weapon, function() self.charge = 0 self.buff:SetValue(0) end) self.script:SetUpdateInterval(0.1) end function ChargedShot:OnUpdated(dt) if self.buff == nil or not WeaponAPI.IsReloaded(self.weapon) then return end self.charge = math.min(self.charge + dt / self.chargeTime, 1) self.buff:SetValue(self.charge * self.maxBonus) end function ChargedShot:OnDestroyed() self.gearLights:SetActive(isDown) end) end self.vehicle = nil self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(false) return end self.script:SetUpdateEnabled(self.fan ~= nil or self.smoke ~= nil) end function local handler = assert(load("local total = 8\nlocal sum = total + 4\nreturn sum", source))
local observed
local thread = coroutine.create(function()
 debug.sethook(function(_, line)

 local name, value = debug.getlocal(2, 1)
 if name == "total" then observed = value end
 end
 end, "l")

end)

assert(ok, err)

manual/mod/map-workshop-asset-build.html.title: 20. 地图工坊素材构建 Map Workshop Asset Build | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/map-workshop-asset-build.html.summary: 20. 地图工坊素材构建 Map Workshop Asset Build 1. 暂时只支持 URP Currently URP Only 建议新建一个模组工程，然后打开 Package Manager 安装 Universal RP。 It is recommended to create a new Mod project, then open the Package Manager and install Universal RP. 2. 素材准备 Asset Preparation 将模型拖入场景，设置坐标为 0, 0, 0，旋转为 0, 0, 0。 Drag the model into the scene, then set its position to 0, 0, 0 and its rotation to 0, 0, 0. 添加碰撞体（Box Collider / Mesh Collider）。 Add a collider (Box Collider / Mesh Collider). 将模型的图层全部设置为 Building（在父物体上设置图层时，可勾选选项以应用于所有子物体）。 Set the layer of the whole model to Building. (When you set the layer on the parent object, a dialog lets you apply it to all child objects as well.) 将此模型拖回 Project 窗口，使其变为 Prefab（预制体）。 Drag the model back into the Project window and it becomes a prefab. 3. 创建数据文件 Create the Data Asset 在已创建的 Prefab 上右键，选择 PropFromSelection，并选择保存路径（请选择项目内的路径）。 Right click the prefab you just created and choose PropFromSelection, then pick a save path (the path must be inside the project). 找到创建出的数据文件，将渲染类型修改为 URP，然后点击更新预制体与更新缩略图。 Open the generated data asset, change the render type to URP, then click update prefab and update thumbnail. 4. 打包 Build 创建 DIYMapDataBuildAssemble，点击自动设置所有打包，将创建的 DIYMapDataBuildAssemble 添加到 ModBuildPipline 中，即可正常打包。同时，可以将重复的资源加入到 LinkedObject，勾选加载依赖资源、共享相同材质球、共享相同模型，以减小模组包体大小。 Create a DIYMapDataBuildAssemble and click the button that sets up all build entries automatically, then add the DIYMapDataBuildAssemble to the ModBuildPipline. It can then be built as usual. You can also add duplicated assets to LinkedObject and enable load dependent assets, share identical materials and share identical models, which reduces the size of the mod package.

end

 assert(math.abs(read.a - expect) < .015, tostring(read.a) .. ' != ' .. tostring(expect))
 end
end)
U.RenderTexture.active = active
for _, asset in ipairs({ material, metal, ao, smooth, readout, target }) do U.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset) end

", "tutorial-mask", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "SDK RGBA channels and roughness passed" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/DeleteAsset", "args": [ "Assets/TutorialMaskTest" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } } ] 将输出用作材质的遮罩贴图。回放验证了 SDK shader 的数值和粗糙度分支，最终外观在载具材质上检查。

manual/mod/mod-mirror-site-setup.html.title: 41. Mod Mirror Site Setup Guide 模组镜像站点搭建指南 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/mod-mirror-site-setup.html.summary: 41. Mod Mirror Site Setup Guide 模组镜像站点搭建指南 Source 源 We have compiled all the Mods, their update dates, and download links in the following JSON file: We will refresh this JSON file every 12 hours. https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json 我们将所有的模组、更新日期及其下载链接整理在如下 JSON 文件中。 我们会每 12 小时刷新一次该 JSON 文件。 https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json Run script 一键下载脚本 We have thoughtfully prepared a Python script for you that allows one-click downloading of all Mods. You can use it directly. 我们贴心地为你准备了一键下载所有模组的 Python 脚本，你可以直接使用。 Dependence 脚本依赖 Before running the script, please ensure that the following dependencies are installed in your Python environment: 在运行脚本之前，请确保你的 Python 环境中已安装以下依赖项： requests: for handling HTTP requests. 用于处理 HTTP 请求。 tqdm: for displaying progress bars. 用于显示进度条。 You can install the dependencies using the following command: 你可以通过以下命令安装依赖： pip install requests tqdm Run Script 运行脚本 import os import json import requests import zipfile import re from datetime import datetime from tqdm import tqdm # Path to the JSON file that tracks downloaded files TRACKING_FILE = 'downloaded_files.json' TEMP_DIR = 'tmp' # Temporary directory for incomplete downloads SAVE_DIR = 'packages' # Base directory where all files will be saved PLATFORM_FOLDERS = { 'PlatformAndroid': 'android', 'PlatformWin64': 'win64', 'PlatformIos': 'ios' } def load_downloaded_files(): """Load the list of downloaded files from the tracking JSON file.""" if os.path.exists(TRACKING_FILE): with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'r') as file: return json.load(file) return {} def save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, url, local_path): """Save the downloaded file information to the tracking JSON file.""" downloaded_files[url] = local_path with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def sanitize_mod_name(mod_name): # Remove only special characters that are not allowed in file names return re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*]', '', mod_name) def download_file(url, temp_path): try: response = requests.get(url, stream=True) response.raise_for_status() total_size = int(response.headers.get('content-length', 0)) block_size = 8192 # 8KB progress_bar = tqdm(total=total_size, unit='iB', unit_scale=True, desc=os.path.basename(temp_path), leave=False) with open(temp_path, 'wb') as file: for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=block_size): progress_bar.update(len(chunk)) file.write(chunk) progress_bar.close() if total_size != 0 and progress_bar.n != total_size: print(f"Warning: Downloaded file size mismatch for {temp_path}") else: print(f"Downloaded: {temp_path}") except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to download {url}: {e}") def extract_mod_name_from_zip(zip_path): if os.path.exists(zip_path): # Check if the file exists before attempting to open it with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref: if 'package.json' in zip_ref.namelist(): with zip_ref.open('package.json') as package_file: package_data = json.load(package_file) # Check for defaultName in localizedModName mod_name = package_data.get('modName', 'default') localized_mod_name = package_data.get('localizedModName', {}) default_name = localized_mod_name.get('defaultName', '').strip() # Prioritize defaultName if it exists and is not empty if default_name: mod_name = default_name return sanitize_mod_name(mod_name) return None def validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files): """Check if the files recorded in the tracking JSON exist locally, and remove any entries that don't.""" missing_files = [] for url, path in list(downloaded_files.items()): if not os.path.exists(path): print(f"File missing: {path}. Removing from tracking.") missing_files.append(url) for url in missing_files: del downloaded_files[url] # Save the updated tracking list if missing_files: with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files): if not os.path.exists(TEMP_DIR): os.makedirs(TEMP_DIR) if not os.path.exists(SAVE_DIR): os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR) with tqdm(total=len(json_data), desc="Overall Progress", unit="file") as overall_progress: for file_info in json_data: file_name = file_info['file_name'] download_link = file_info['download_link'] # Skip if the file is already recorded as downloaded if download_link in downloaded_files: if os.path.exists(downloaded_files[download_link]): print(f"File already downloaded, skipping: {downloaded_files[download_link]}") overall_progress.update(1) continue else: print(f"File {downloaded_files[download_link]} is missing. Redownloading.") del downloaded_files[download_link] # Define the temporary download path temp_file_path = os.path.join(TEMP_DIR, file_name) # Download the file to the temporary location download_file(download_link, temp_file_path) # Extract modName and rename the file with the prefix mod_name = extract_mod_name_from_zip(temp_file_path) if mod_name: new_file_name = f"{mod_name}-#-#-{file_name}" else: new_file_name = file_name # Determine the platform folder based on the filename for platform, folder in PLATFORM_FOLDERS.items(): if platform in file_name: final_dir = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, folder) break else: final_dir = SAVE_DIR # Default to base save directory if no platform is found if not os.path.exists(final_dir): os.makedirs(final_dir) final_file_path = os.path.join(final_dir, new_file_name) # Move the file from the temporary location to the final directory os.rename(temp_file_path, final_file_path) print(f"Moved to: {final_file_path}") # Update the tracking dictionary save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, download_link, final_file_path) overall_progress.update(1) if __name__ == "__main__": json_url = 'https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json' try: response = requests.get(json_url) response.raise_for_status() json_data = response.json() except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to retrieve JSON file from {json_url}: {e}") json_data = [] if json_data: downloaded_files = load_downloaded_files() validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files) # Ensure the tracked files exist download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files) File synchronization to NetDisk 文件同步至网盘 Using UC NetDisk as an example, automatically back up the packages folder and wait for the synchronization to complete. Once the synchronization is finished, share this folder with the players. This completes the setup of the NetDisk mirror site. 以 UC 网盘为例，自动备份 packages 文件夹，并等待同步完成。同步结束后，将此文件夹共享给玩家，即完成网盘镜像站的搭建。 Alternative Mirror Site Setup Solutions 其他镜像站搭建方案 You can use tools like Nginx to set up a dedicated Mod download site. This helps to offload the traffic from the official downloader and improves download speeds. 可使用 Nginx 等工具搭建专属的模组下载站点，以分流官方下载器的流量压力，并提高下载速度。

manual/mod/modding-issue-archive.html.summary: 模组开发问题归档 中文 | English 这里记录旧版工具中遇到的问题和当时的排查方法。截图中的参数和入口来自当时的版本。 1. 地图空气碰撞 现象：地图某处存在看不见的碰撞，物体或弹道在该区域被挡住。 当时的排查：选中所有物体，检查是否有绿色碰撞框覆盖该区域；检查复制时是否多复制了一个 Mesh Collider，或把 Mesh Collider 放在了与显示模型不同的位置。 2. 悬挂回弹慢、转弯翻车 现象：车辆悬挂回弹缓慢，转弯时容易翻车。 当时的排查：检查 Wheel Collider 配置。下图为旧文档中称为“默认悬挂配置”的截图，仅作历史示例。 3. 地图炮弹碰撞与显示层级 旧文档用下图记录当时的地图炮弹碰撞与显示层级设置。 4. Blender 材质球重复问题 现象：用 Blender 复制物体后出现重复材质球。 旧文档记录了当时键位设置下两种复制方式得到的材质结果。使用当前 Blender 时，以你所用的键位和实际结果为准。 历史截图：使用 ctrl c 与 ctrl v 后的重复材质球。 历史截图：使用 shift + d 复制物体的结果。

manual/mod/official-art-assets.html.title: 28. Official Art Assets 官方美术资产库 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/official-art-assets.html.summary: 28. Official Art Assets 官方美术资产库 Repository 项目地址 Access to the repositories requires permission. Send your email address to the developers to apply. 仓库访问需要申请权限，请将邮箱地址发送给开发者。 Community Repository 通用仓库： https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/panzer-war-community-mods Sound Repository 音效仓库： https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/Panzer-War-Fmod Map Repository 地图仓库**（需与 Community Repository 父目录一致）** Must be cloned under the same parent directory as the Community Repository. 地图：https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/ShanghaiWindyMaps 公用资源：https://lab.windyverse.net/modder/ShanghaiWindyPublicResources Contribution 贡献方式 Use git to pull the project and create your own branch. Then push your branch. The developer will merge your branch to master branch. 使用 git 拉取项目，创建你的分支，然后推送该分支。开发者会将你的分支合并至 master 分支。 Tutorial 使用项目教程 Video 视频教程 装甲纷争 模组工程项目下载 使用 与提交修改教程_单机游戏热门视频 装甲纷争 模组工程 编写自定义脚本 以及调整载具数值_哔哩哔哩_bilibili Text 文本教程 1. Install Git 安装 Git 安装 Git 2. Install TortoiseGit 安装小乌龟 Git 2. 安装小乌龟 3. Pull Project 拉取项目 Click Git clone after installing TortoiseGit. 安装完 TortoiseGit 后，在右键菜单中点击 Git Clone... Open our repository and click clone. Copy the https link. 打开我们的项目地址，点击克隆，复制 https 链接。 Paste it into url 将其粘贴到 URL 输入框中。 Fill in the account in our gitlab. 输入我们在 GitLab 上的账号与密码。 4. Open the Project 打开项目 The main file is located at Assets/Res/Vehicles/Ground/Data 主要项目文件位于： Assets/Res/Vehicles/Ground/Data 路径下。 5. Commit Changes 提交修改 Follow the illustrated steps below to create a branch and commit your changes. 按照下方图文步骤创建分支并提交修改。 After creating the changes to the project, you need to create your own branch and commit changes. 当完成对工程的修改后，需要创建一个属于你的分支，然后再提交你的修改。 Create the branch. (Right click in the project folder!) 创建分支（请确保在项目文件夹内点击右键）。 Fill in the branch name. The branch name should be XXX-mod, where XXX describes what you changed. For example, the tank you modified and the content you modified on it. 输入分支名称。分支名称应为 XXX-mod，其中 XXX 应描述你的修改内容。例如：为 xxx 坦克修改了 xxx 内容。 Switch to your branch 然后切换到你的分支。 Toggle on your changes and commit. If some changes are not modified by yourself. Then do not toggle 勾选你自己的修改项，然后点击 Commit。如果看到有文件不是自己修改的，请勿勾选。 Click Push 点击 Push。 Confirm the branch name and click ok. 确认分支名称，然后点击 OK。 You can push many commits to your branch. As long as the modification is done. You can notify the developer to merge your changes to the game. 你可以在自己创建的分支进行多次修改提交。在确认自己的分支修改无误后，通知开发者合并你的分支。开发者会检查内容是否可以合入 master 主分支。在修改的内容被合入 master 主分支后，可执行下面一个步骤回到最新的项目。 6. Sync to the latest 同步项目到最新 After your changes are merged into master. You need to switch back to master and pull the latest project. The master branch contains your changes and others changes. 在你的分支被合入 master 主分支后，需要切回 master 分支，然后拉取最新工程。此时，工程会包含你的修改以及其他人的修改。 Switch back to master branch. 切回 master 分支。 Pull the latest files Pull 拉取最新的文件。 Now, the project is the latest. 此时，工程即为最新版本。若需要在最新的工程上进行修改，请重复步骤 5 的提交流程，创建新的分支提交即可。 If some error poped. Then click stash changes and then pull. 若拉取过程中出现报错，则点击 Stash Changes 按钮，然后再点击 Pull。 After pull then click stash pop 在 Pull 执行完毕后，点击 Stash Pop。 Git tools inside the editor 使用编辑器内 Git 工具 Using Git is the recommended way. 推荐使用 Git 方式。 Create a branch and commit changes 创建分支并提交修改 Pull the latest project 拉取最新项目 Switch back to the master branch, then click download and overwrite. 切换回 master 分支，然后点击下载并覆盖。 Notes 注意事项 Configuration file errors 配置文件报错 If a configuration file shows as Missing, report which file it is to the developers. 若存在配置文件显示为 Missing，请向开发者反馈具体是哪个文件。

manual/mod/physics-wheels.html.summary: 配置轮式载具 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run physics-wheels --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_WheeledVehicle.asset", "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_WheeledBody.prefab", "collider": "${fixture}/Tutorial_WheelCollider.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 当前载具使用 TrackController 的轮式模式。旧教程在车体根节点使用 NPhysicCarController、Rigidbody、CenterOfMass 和 NPhysic，并给每个轮子挂 WheelController 和摩擦预设。迁移旧工程时可以根据这些名字认出旧配置。当前模式由 PTCParameter 选择，车轮和摩擦使用下述轮碰撞器模板。 1. 准备车体和轮子节点 按载具基础配置准备车体。在显示模型根节点下建立 Wheels，下面放 FrontLeft、FrontRight、RearLeft、RearRight。从侧面和正面检查每个轮子原点在对应车轴中心，左右轮模型方向一致。构建后的 VehicleDynamics 和 Wheels 使用同一父节点，组装器会创建 VehicleDynamics。 根节点已有 Rigidbody 时，打包器会用它。否则会根据载具参数生成。用 VehicleData → 编辑移动橙色的 Center Of Gravity 节点，在 Scene 视图按 K 保存重心调整。 图中展示最终完成后的移动配置。TankWheelCollider 提供轮胎碰撞器参数，isWheelVehicle 打开轮式模式。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "create", "component": "UnityEngine.Rigidbody", "children": [ "VehicleDynamics", "Wheels/FrontLeft", "Wheels/FrontRight", "Wheels/RearLeft", "Wheels/RearRight" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_VehicleTextData.asset", "${vehicle}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/isStationary", "value": "false" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. 按驱动和转向分组 在 VehicleTextData 的「移动」页签展开 PTCParameter。把带 Unity WheelCollider 的模板 prefab 指给 TankWheelCollider。模板的半径、悬挂和摩擦参数会复制到运行时轮子。每组可用 steerData.wheelCollider 指定自己的模板，留空则沿用总模板。 在 steerableWheels 中建两组。wheels 的路径从 VehicleDynamics 的父节点查找。 分组 路径 isMotor isSteerable maxSteerAngle 前轮 Wheels/FrontLeft、Wheels/FrontRight true true 28° 后轮 Wheels/RearLeft、Wheels/RearRight true false 0° 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CopyAsset", "args": [ "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.coreresources/BuiltInVehicles/PatriotRadar/BuiltIn-Patriot-Radar_WheelCollider.prefab", "${collider}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PTCParameter/TankWheelCollider", "value": "@asset:${collider}" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PTCParameter/steerableWheels", "value": "[{\"wheels\": [\"Wheels/FrontLeft\", \"Wheels/FrontRight\"], \"steerData\": {\"isMotor\": true, \"isSteerable\": true, \"maxSteerAngle\": 28}}, {\"wheels\": [\"Wheels/RearLeft\", \"Wheels/RearRight\"], \"steerData\": {\"isMotor\": true, \"isSteerable\": false, \"maxSteerAngle\": 0}}]" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 3. 启用轮式模式 在相同的移动配置内勾选 isWheelVehicle。本例不使用履带数据，将 TrackData 留空。确认固定底座开关关闭，载具按普通地面载具进入 TrackController 分支。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PTCParameter/isWheelVehicle", "value": "true" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/PTCParameter/TrackData", "value": "null" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 4. 保存并核对 保存车体与配置并重打包。核对每个轮子的路径都指向一个车轴节点。用测试场在平地试车，观察轮胎是否接地、前轮是否随输入转向、后轮是否保持方向，再测试有坡度的地面。方向不对时先查模型轴向和分组，抓地力异常时查当前组实际引用的 WheelCollider 模板。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetGroundType()" }, "expect": { "contains": "TrackController" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetEngineParam()/isWheelVehicle" }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetEngineParam()/TankWheelCollider/WheelCollider/radius" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single)" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${vehicle}/GetEngineParam()/steerableWheels/0/steerData/maxSteerAngle" }, "expect": { "contains": "28" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Wheels/FrontLeft/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "FrontLeft" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Wheels/FrontRight/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "FrontRight" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Wheels/RearLeft/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "RearLeft" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Wheels/RearRight/name" }, "expect": manual/mod/reactive-armor.html.title: 配置反应装甲 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/reactive-armor.html.summary: 配置反应装甲 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run reactive-armor --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "plate": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ReactivePlate.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 在载具伤害模型的 HitBox 上配置反应装甲。反应装甲会在有效命中点附近记录已消耗区域。 1. 选择 HitBox 打开载具的伤害模型 prefab，选中作为反应装甲的装甲部件。确认该物体有 HitBox 组件。教学配方新建一个独立的装甲样例。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "create", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox" } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. 设置反应装甲参数 将「装甲类型」设为「反应 - Reactive」。展开「反应装甲」，将「反应装甲区块大小」设为 0.5，「反应装甲最大防御穿深厚度」设为 200。本例使用源码默认值。 区块大小是从已激活命中点量起的距离。后续命中落在该范围内时，该位置返回的装甲值为 0。未消耗位置使用配置的反应装甲值，是否击穿还取决于游戏的穿深计算。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${plate}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.HitBox", "values": { "hitBoxType": 3, "reactiveArmorSize": 0.5, "reactiveMaxProtectPenetration": 200 } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. 保存并核对 保存 prefab，重新核对装甲类型和两个数值。配方验证了编辑器保存回读。区块消耗、重复命中及修复应在游戏中检查。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/hitBoxType" }, "expect": { "contains": "ReactiveArmor" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/reactiveArmorSize" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 0.5" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${plate}/HitBox/reactiveMaxProtectPenetration" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 200" } } ]

manual/mod/shader-variant-collection.htm.title: 37. 着色器收集与打包 Shader Variant Collection and Build | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/shader-variant-collection.htm.summary: 37. 着色器收集与打包 Shader Variant Collection and Build 如果使用任何自定义着色器，请按以下方式收集其变体： If you use any custom shader, collect its variants as follows. 开启开发模式 Enable developer mode. 创建变体收集 Create a shader variant collection. 在模组打包文件上，选择刚刚创建的变体收集。 On the Mod build asset, select the variant collection you just created. 如果着色器存在自定义的着色器特性，则需将其填写在变体收集的列表中。 If the shader has custom shader features, you need to fill them into the list of the variant collection. 点击导出 Shader 变体 Click export shader variants. 会在模组打包文件下方，生成一份 svc 文件 An svc file will be generated under the Mod build asset. 拖入打包的资源列表，并勾选上共享相同的着色器。 Drag it into the asset list of the build, and tick share identical shaders. 打包后，我们会将所有的 Shader 放在一个 .shader 文件下。以保证所有的材质之间的shader ，公用一份。 After the build, all shaders are placed in a single .shader file, so that every material shares one copy of the shader. Fog 关键词 Fog Keywords _FOG_LINEAR _FOG_EXP _FOG_EXP2

spg-td-hydraulic-suspension --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "vehicle": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TurretVehicle.asset", "shared": "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 在 VehicleTextData 中为主炮塔选择动作资产。下面用独立的教学资产演示 TD、SPG 和 Strv 三种配置，以及 SharedTurretData 的优先级。 1. 创建炮塔动作资产 在 Project 窗口选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Turret Action - 炮塔逻辑，分别创建 TD - 反坦、SPG - 火炮 和 Hydraulic - 液压 资产。分别命名为 Tutorial_TD、Tutorial_SPG 和 Tutorial_Hydraulic。每个炮塔参数有一个 actionData 槽位。TD 资产用于启用车体辅助转向，资产本身没有额外参数。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.SPGTurretAction)", "${spg}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.TDTurretAction)", "${td}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateAsset", "args": [ "@static:UnityEngine.ScriptableObject/CreateInstance(ShanghaiWindy.Core.StrvTurretAction)", "${strv}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 2. 设置 SPG 瞄准参数 选中 Tutorial_SPG，将 maxDistance 设为 450。该值用于更新上帝视角相机，并参与计算目标不可达时的备用弹道预览时长。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${spg}/maxDistance", "value": "450" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } } ] 3. 设置 Strv 液压参数 选中 Tutorial_Hydraulic。本例保留三个攻击模式速度修正的默认值，填写以下悬挂与自动控制参数。 字段 值 attackingSuspension 0.5 wheelElevateClamp 0.45 maxElevateAnglePerSecond 0.1 autoPidFactors (3, 0, 2.5) Unity 校验资产时会取前三个值的绝对值，并将 manual/mod/tank-shell-ejection-animation.summary: 制作坦克抛壳动画 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run tank-shell-ejection-animation --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "rig": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx", "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellRig.prefab", "clip": "${fixture}/Tutorial_ShellEject.anim", "script": "${fixture}/PlayAnimationComponent.lua" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 本教程改编自樱花的《坦克抛壳动画》。示例先在 Blender 准备炮塔下的弹壳和抛壳装置，再在 Unity 制作动画，最后用 Lua 将剪辑接到开火事件。 1. 准备并导入模型 在 Blender 中将弹壳放到炮塔内，设为炮塔的子级。本例将弹壳节点命名为 Casing。把抛壳装置的枢轴设在旋转中心。如果旋转轴和全局坐标轴不重合，可以放置并旋转一个空物体作为父级。本例用 MechanismPivot 表示这个空物体。 导出 FBX 后导入 Unity，确认模型下保留 Turret/Casing 和 Turret/MechanismPivot，再创建用于配置的 prefab。配方用 Blender 后台模式生成并导出教学样例。如果 Unity 找不到 Blender，启动编辑器前设置 BLENDER 指向可执行文件。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/ExportRig", "args": [ "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellRig.fbx" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/EnsureRigPrefab", "args": [ "${rig}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/Casing/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Casing" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Turret/MechanismPivot/Mechanism/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "(String) Mechanism" } } ] 2. 制作并分配动画 在 Unity 的 Animation 窗口中选择 prefab 根节点，创建 Tutorial_ShellEject.anim 剪辑。为 Casing 的局部 Position 添加起点、抛出和复位三个关键帧。本例在 0.2 秒沿局部 X 轴移动 0.35 个单位，在 0.4 秒回到起点。装置通过 MechanismPivot 的局部 Rotation 曲线在 0.2 秒转到 35° 的打开姿态，随后复位。 将剪辑设为 Legacy，Wrap Mode 保持 Default。在根节点添加 Animation，指定默认剪辑并关闭 Play Automatically，让 Lua 控制播放。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/WriteClip", "args": [ "${fixture}", "${model}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Turret/Casing/m_LocalPosition.x: 3 keys" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/AssignClip", "args": [ "${model}", "${clip}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellEject" } } ] 3. 绑定开火事件 在同一个根节点添加 LuaBehaviorMono，将以下脚本保存为 PlayAnimationComponent.lua 并赋给「行为脚本」。脚本在载具加载后监听第一个火力系统的开火事件。多炮载具应按实际火力列表选择索引。 Behavior() Property = {} local PlayAnimationComponent = class("PlayAnimationComponent") function PlayAnimationComponent:OnStarted() local animation = self.script:GetNativeComponent("Animation") local found, vehicle = self.script:TryGetTankInitSystem() if not animation or not found then return end VehicleAPI.RegisterVehicleLoadedEvent(vehicle, function() VehicleAPI.RegisterBulletFiredEvent(vehicle, 0, function() animation:Play() end) end) end return PlayAnimationComponent 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.ShellEjectionAuthoring/ImportBehavior", "args": [ "${fixture}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "PlayAnimationComponent.lua" } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.Lua.LuaBehaviorMono", "references": [ { "property": "luaBehavior", "asset": "${script}", "type": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.Lua.LuaBehaviorScript" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 4. 保存并核对 保存 prefab，检查 Animation 和 LuaBehaviorMono 在同一个节点上，再核对默认剪辑、Legacy 设置和 Lua 引用。配方回读了位置曲线和旋转曲线。还需在完整载具上试射，确认开火回调和动画在游戏中按预期运行。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${clip}/legacy" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) True" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${clip}/wrapMode" }, "expect": { "contains": "Default" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Animation/clip/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "Tutorial_ShellEject" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/Animation/playAutomatically" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) False" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/LuaBehaviorMono/luaBehavior/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "PlayAnimationComponent" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/LuaBehaviorMono/luaBehavior/lua" }, "expect": { "contains": "RegisterBulletFiredEvent" } } ]

manual/mod/texture-channel-conversion-to.title: 合并与拆分 ORM 贴图 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/texture-channel-conversion-to.summary:
合并与拆分 ORM 贴图 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run texture-channel-conversion-tools 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "texture": "${fixture}/TutorialORM.png" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "(String)" } } ] } 在 Substance 3D Designer 中，把环境遮蔽（AO）、粗糙度和金属度分别接到 RGBA Merge 的 R、G 和 B。需要明确的 Alpha 时给 A 接白色常量。Adobe RGBA Merge 编辑已有 ORM 时，先用 RGBA Split 拆出通道，再按所需顺序接回 RGBA Merge。Adobe RGBA Split 将结果作为线性数据贴图导出。导入 Unity 后关闭 sRGB。装甲纷争的 Mask 使用另一套映射，见 PBR 遮罩合并教程。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 Unity 小样分别写入三个测试值并回读 PNG。Designer 的接线按 Adobe 文档。 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Core.AssetBundleManager/LuaEnv/DoString", "args": [ "local U = CS.UnityEngine
local source = U.Texture2D(2, 2, U.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false, true)
local color = U.Color(0.18, 0.42, 0.72, 1)
for x = 0, 1 do
 for y = 0, 1 do source:SetPixel(x, y, color) end
end
source:Apply()
local png = U.ImageConversion.EncodeToPNG(source)
CS.System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes('${texture}', png)
local copy = U.Texture2D(2, 2, U.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false, true)
assert(U.ImageConversion.LoadImage(copy, png, false))
local pixel = copy:GetPixel(0, 0)
assert(math.abs(color.r - pixel.r) < .005 and math.abs(color.g - pixel.g) < .005)
assert(math.abs(color.b - pixel.b) < .005 and math.abs(color.a - pixel.a) < .005)
U.Object.DestroyImmediate(source)
U.Object.DestroyImmediate(copy)
return "PNG channel sample verified"
", "tutorial-orm", "null" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "PNG channel sample verified" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/ImportAsset", "args": [ "${texture}", "ForceSynchronousImport" ] }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "importer:${texture}/sRGBTexture", "value": "false" }, "expect": { "contains": "OK:" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "importer:${texture}/sRGBTexture" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Boolean) False" } } ]

manual/mod/track-ik-suspension.html.summary: 配置 Track IK 悬挂臂 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 命令也会重拍两种语言的配图。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run track-ik-suspension --capture 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "model": "${fixture}/Tutorial_TrackIK.prefab" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } TrackIK 让悬挂臂随负重轮的位移旋转。以下用同一模型 prefab 内的一根悬挂臂和一个负重轮演示。 1. 准备模型层级 把悬挂臂拆成独立节点，将转轴放在车体连接处。在 MainBody 下准备 SuspensionArm 和 RoadWheel。在同一模型 prefab 内新建空节点 StandardUCS，将它的上轴和右轴分别对齐到车体的上方和侧方。负重轮应位于悬挂臂转轴前方。本例将轮节点放在局部坐标 (0, -0.25, 1)。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "create", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "children": [ "MainBody/SuspensionArm", "MainBody/RoadWheel", "StandardUCS" ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } }, { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform", "child": "MainBody/RoadWheel", "values": { "m_LocalPosition": { "x": 0, "y": -0.25, "z": 1 } } } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 2. 配置 TrackIK 在 SuspensionArm 上添加 TrackIK，将「目标负重轮」设为 RoadWheel，将「参考坐标系」设为 StandardUCS。本例将高度设为 0.1，翻转符号设为 1。 保持「使用旋转包装节点」开启。运行时会在转轴处创建包装节点，用它的局部 Z+ 对准目标方向，同时保留网格相对于包装节点的初始摆放。关闭时脚本直接旋转悬挂臂，因此模型自身的 Z+ 要沿悬挂臂前向。 对左右两侧的所有悬挂臂重复配置。以旧版 KV-2 示例为例，MainBody/TrackIK_011 指向左侧第六个负重轮 L6，参考坐标系使用模型根节点下的 StandardUCS。每根臂应按实际位置绑定对应轮子。旧图的 Height 为 0，本页教学值 0.1 用于演示高度偏移。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "prefab_edit", "arguments": { "json": { "path": "${model}", "mode": "update", "component": "ShanghaiWindy.Core.TrackIK", "child": "MainBody/SuspensionArm", "values": { "isFlip": 1, "height": 0.1, "useTransformWrapper": true }, "references": [ { "property": "target", "child": "MainBody/RoadWheel", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform" }, { "property": "standardUCS", "child": "StandardUCS", "component": "UnityEngine.Transform" } ] } }, "expect": { "equals": { "ok": true } } } ] 3. 保存并核对 在碰撞预制体的 Prefab Mode 保存并退出，重新检查每根臂的两个 Transform 引用。Scene 视图选中悬挂臂时，可用它指向负重轮的连线核对绑定。修改后重新打包，开进测试场观察悬挂转向和高度偏移。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/MainBody/SuspensionArm/TrackIK/target/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "RoadWheel" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/MainBody/SuspensionArm/TrackIK/standardUCS/name" }, "expect": { "contains": "StandardUCS" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/MainBody/SuspensionArm/TrackIK/height" }, "expect": { "contains": "0.1" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/MainBody/SuspensionArm/TrackIK/useTransformWrapper" }, "expect": { "contains": "True" } }, { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${model}/MainBody/RoadWheel/transform/localPosition/z" }, "expect": { "contains": "(Single) 1" } } ]

manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.title: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-naming-art-standards.h.summary: 28.1. Upload, Naming and Art Standards 上传、命名与美术规范 1. Upload Standards 上传规范 每个分支应尽可能减少修改内容。理想情况下，一个分支仅包含一辆坦克或一架飞机的修改。切记，不要在一个分支内提交大量载具修改后再进行合并，此类合并将无法通过。 Each branch should contain as few changes as possible — ideally one branch per tank or aircraft. Never commit a large batch of vehicle changes on a single branch and then ask for a merge; such merges will not be accepted. 2. Naming Standards 命名规范 任何文件名应以大写字母开头，随后接小写字母，例如： Every file name should begin with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, for example: 任何文件都应具有清晰明确的名称，而非一串乱码。 Every file should have a clear, meaningful name instead of a string of gibberish. 尽量避免拼写错误。 Try not to misspell words. 3. When Modifying an Existing Model, Replace the Fbx Instead of Adding a New One 在原本模型上进行修改，应替换 Fbx 而非新增 Fbx 导出新的 fbx 并覆盖原本的 fbx 文件。此步骤可在建模软件导出时执行，或在文件夹中通过复制文件进行覆盖。无法在 Unity 编辑器内直接完成。如果在 fbx 内新增了模型，请将新的 fbx 拖入空场景，然后将新增部分复制到原本的旧预制体内。 Export the new fbx and overwrite the original fbx file. You can overwrite it while exporting from your modelling software, or by copying the file over in the folder. This cannot be done directly inside the Unity editor. If you added new models inside the fbx, drag the new fbx into an empty scene, then copy the newly added parts into the original old prefab. 切记，不要因为对 fbx 新增一块区域的模型，就只是新增一个 fbx 文件。这会导致出现 XXX_fix.fbx、XXX_fix2.fbx 等文件，造成项目文件混乱。 Never add a separate fbx file just because you added one more piece of geometry. It leads to XXX_fix.fbx, XXX_fix2.fbx and so on, which turns the project files into a mess. 4. Do Not Reuse One Texture for Both Normal and RGB Maps, and Do Not Set Normal Strength 法线图与 RGB 图不要用一张，不要设置 Normal 强度 解决方法： Solution: 在建模软件中，不要将 RGB 图引用给 Normal，也不要设置 Normal 强度。 In your modelling software, do not feed the RGB map into Normal, and do not set the Normal strength. 例如，在 Blender 中删除以下节点： For example, in Blender, delete the following node: 以及删除以下节点： And delete the following node as well: 5. Avoid Duplicate Materials 避免重复的材质球 重复的材质球指的是使用相同贴图但应用了不同材质球的情况。这会增加渲染压力。 Duplicate materials means separate materials that use exactly the same textures. This increases the rendering cost. 重复的材质球通常出现在 Blender 中使用 Ctrl+C 和 Ctrl+V 复制物体时。我们建议使用 Shift+D 的方式复制物体，以避免创建重复的材质球。 Duplicate materials usually appear after copying objects in Blender with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V. We recommend duplicating objects with Shift+D instead, so that no duplicate material is created. 对于已经创建的重复材质球，需要在 Blender 中手动将引用的材质球统一替换为相同的材质，以避免重复。 For duplicates that already exist, you have to switch the referenced materials manually in Blender so that they all point to the same material. 下拉框可以显示目前还有哪些材质存在重复，通常重复的材质名称会以 .001、.002 结尾。 The dropdown shows which materials are still duplicated; duplicated ones normally end with .001, .002 and so on. 可以使用上方的搜索框搜索重复的材质名称。 You can use the search box above to look up duplicated material names.

manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.title: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/upload-to-modhub.html.summary: 36. Upload to Official ModHub 上传模组到官方平台 We understand that creating Mods is not easy, but due to reasons such as model accuracy and data parameters, you may encounter dissatisfaction from some players. Please ensure you are mentally prepared before proceeding with the upload. 我们明白制作模组不易，但由于模型考据、数据参数等原因，你可能会遭到部分玩家的不满。请确保你已经做好充分的心理准备再进行上传。 Upload Qualifications 上传资格 All Mod authors can upload their Mods without undergoing a review process. However, only Mods that are original are eligible for upload. Please ensure that the Mods you upload comply with the CC BY-NC license. By uploading a Mod, you agree to the principles of free and open sharing, making the Mod freely available for distribution by any player without restrictions. Note: Mods with copyright disputes will not qualify for incentives. 所有模组作者可以无需审核直接上传模组。但请确保上传的模组为原创。上传的模组必须遵守 CC BY-NC 协议。上传即代表自愿公开流通模组，同意模组以自由的方式传播，不限制任何玩家进行传播。注意：上传的模组若存在版权争议将无法获得激励金。 Tool Usages 工具用法 Open the tool - 打开工具 Enter Your Account - 输入你的账号密码 Configure your account and click save at the bottom 配置你的账号，然后点击底部的保存选项 Pick the account by clicking this button 点击此按钮选择你的账号 Pick File 选择文件 Pick a mod package file to upload, or pick a folder by the second button 选择模组文件进行上传，或者通过第二个按钮，批量上传文件夹中的 mod package 文件 If you need to upgrade the Mod, then need to change the version. +1 version to make it upgradable. 若模组需要进行更新，则需要进行版本变更，需要 +1 的版本号，才可正常进行更新。 Contract with us 与我们签订创作激励收益 Once your original, high-quality, and free Mod achieves a certain number of downloads on the Mod downloader, we will offer you an incentive agreement. This agreement will provide a reward ranging from 50 to 500 SGD, depending on the quality of your Mod. Please note that a Singapore bank account is required to receive the reward. 一旦你的原创、高质量、免费的模组在模组下载器上达到一定的下载量，我们将与你签订激励协议。根据模组的质量，我们会提供 50 至 500 新币不等的奖励。请注意，需要提供一张新加坡银行卡来接收奖励。 Prohibition of Illegal Use of Mods 禁止非法利用模组 It is strictly forbidden for any user to utilize uploaded public Mods and their related files for illegal fundraising, fraud, or commercial activities in any form. If such behavior is discovered, we will pursue legal action in accordance with the law. 严禁任何使用者以任何形式利用已上传的公开模组及其相关文件进行非法集资、诈骗或商业活动。如发现此类行为，我们将依法追究相关法律责任。

中为载具保留一个根对象。选择子对象，再按住 Shift 选择它的父对象，通过 Ctrl+P → Object (Keep Transform) 建立父子关系。分离部件时可在 Edit Mode 选中该部件的面，再按 P → Selection。将部件原点放在实际转轴处，避免旋转时围绕车体原点公转。 根对象下的节点 放入的对象与检查项 MainBody 车体网格。 Turret → Gun → Dym 炮塔、主炮俯仰节点、炮管后坐节点。炮塔原点在座圈中心，主炮原点在俯仰轴，炮管向车头伸出。三个节点逐层嵌套。 LeftWheel、RightWheel 空的分组对象。负重轮分别命名 l_1、l_2…和 r_1、r_2…，原点在轮轴中心。 LeftUpperWheel、RightUpperWheel 空的托带轮分组。将两侧托带轮放到各自分组，可分别用 lu_1、ru_1 编号。当前打包器会按前后位置重新排序轮子。 LeftTrack、RightTrack 静态履带网格或对应的占位节点。后面还会为动态履带设置履带节和路径。 在 Blender 按实际尺寸建模，以米为单位。选中前述对象，点 File → Export → FBX。旧教程图中使用 Scale 1.00、Apply Scalings → FBX Units Scale、Forward → −Z Forward 和 Up → Y Up。导入 Unity 后确认 +Z 朝前、+Y 朝上，再用已知长度测量车体。轴向问题参见 Blender 轴向修正。 另存一份低面数的伤害模型。按装甲厚度、材质类型和活动部位拆开板件。在引擎中每块独立设置厚度，随炮塔、主炮或炮管转动的板件后续要挂在相应父节点。内部模块也要独立拆分。按伤害模型命名规范命名后导出。 小型入门载具可沿用旧指南的预算作为起点，显示模型约 2 万面以内、约 4 个材质、贴图 2048 × 2048 或更低，伤害模型约 5000 面以内。先合并重复材质、简化看不见的面和碰撞轮廓，保留可辨识的车体、炮塔与轮组。 把 FBX 拖入 Unity 场景，展开模型根节点。下面是载具工程的 KV-2。先在 Hierarchy 找到 MainBody 与 Turret，再逐级展开 Turret → Gun → Dym，对照 Scene View Distance / Force App Point Distance 0.2 m / 0.4 m 分别是悬挂行程与静止轮底上方的受力点距离。 Suspension Spring Spring 205000、Damper 14500、Target Position 0.5 控制回弹力、缓和振荡和静止目标在行程中的位置。 Forward Friction Extremum Slip / Value 1 / 1，Asymptote Slip / Value 1 / 1，Stiffness 1.7 平地起步、直线刹车，看轮子是否持续打滑。 Sideways Friction Extremum Slip / Value 1.2 / 1.2，Asymptote Slip / Value 1 / 1，Stiffness 4 同样速度转向，比较横向滑移与侧倾。 模板里的 Wheel Damping manual/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.title: 载具模组开发笔记 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/vehicle-modding-notes.html.summary: 载具模组开发笔记 中文 | English 原文作者 @情绪薫。 模型与枢轴 购买或下载模型前，先核对具体资源的改作与分发授权。把炮塔的枢轴放在水平旋转中心，把 Gun 放在俯仰轴上，把 Dym 放在炮管所需原点。车轮枢轴应与轮轴一致。无炮塔载具也可以保留一个空的炮塔节点，为主炮提供所需层级。参见载具基础和轴向修正。 显示与碰撞 内构缺失时检查 VehicleInfo 的模块配置和 HitBox 命名。看不到整个模型时，按模型显示排查检查隐藏状态、层、材质和相机遮罩。 装甲分析出现透明区域时检查法线、碰撞体和装甲分组。爆反的条件见反应装甲。命中特效尺寸异常时检查炮弹口径及特效参数。 模组未出现时，先查看载具开发排查和日志，再沿提示检查打包平台和资源引用。 运动与细节 车库翻转或起步、刹停时俯仰过大，检查质量、重心、轮子接地和摩擦，再按场景测试轮式物理。 雷达旋转等可用 Animator 写在独立枢轴下。履带节点负责跟随负重轮并定义路径。不同方向的俯仰限位应在游戏里逐向检查。 旧载具的顶部武器和同轴武器可参考旧版多炮塔配置。展示图参见载具缩略图。

manual/mod/vehicle-playground.html.title: 在载具测试场调试 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/vehicle-playground.html.summary: 在载具测试场调试 中文 | English 在仓库根目录运行以下命令，用本机 Unity MCP 回放本页示例。 python Docs/Manual/manual/tools/tutorials.py run vehicle-playground 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 准备教学样例。${变量} 由配方提供。 { "variables": { "debugPrefab": "../../../Panzer-War-Mod-SDK/Packages/Sdk/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/Tools/RuntimeDebugger/Prefab/RuntimeDebugTool.prefab" }, "calls": [] } 测试场在 Unity 内加载模组，让你快速检查当前载具，无需先在正式客户端安装。测试工程仅供调试使用，禁止重新打包分发。软件著作权归 WINDYVERSE PTE. LTD. 所有。 1. 启动测试场 按绑定 Steam LuaProject配置 SDK 工程，然后保存当前场景。 在 Project 选中目标 VehicleData，在 Inspector 底部点击试驾（Drive）。刚改过模型、伤害模型或关键数据时，选择**试驾（重打包）**并确认。编辑器会为这辆车生成临时资源，再打开测试场并进入 Play。 单独打开测试场时，在 Framework - 框架 → 0. Home Page 点击 打开测试场。也可在 Project 双击 Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/Tools/RuntimeDebugger/VehiclePlayground.unity，检查下面的模式设置，再按 Play。 2. 模块模式和血条模式 在 Edit Mode 的 Hierarchy 展开 RuntimeDebugTool，选中 Scripts。 在 Editor Mode Startup 组件找到 Damage Mode。保持默认 Module Based 可测试装甲和模块。测试未完成内构的载具时，用 Health Based。 进入 Play，选择要测试的车。检查移动和转向、炮塔和主炮动作。测试装甲或模块时，核对命中效果和预期部件。 3. 退出并重新测试 切回 Unity 工具栏，再点亮着的 Play 退出。旧教程画面会按 Alt 把焦点从 Game 视图释放出来。保留编辑后的数据再重打包试驾，确认测试场使用的是最新版本。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect", "arguments": { "path": "static:ShanghaiWindy.Editor.HomePageWindow/TEST_FIELD_SCENE" }, "expect": { "contains": "Packages/com.shanghaiwindy.middlelayer/Tools/RuntimeDebugger/VehiclePlayground.unity" } }, { "tool": "invoke", "expect": { "regex": "(?s)m_Name: Scripts.*?DamageMode: 0" }, "arguments": { "path": "static:System.IO.File/ReadAllText", "args": [ "${debugPrefab}" ] } } ]

manual/mod/voice-pack-practice.html.title: 26.3. VoicePack As Practice 语音包实战 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/voice-pack-practice.html.summary: 26.3. VoicePack As Practice 语音包实战 As an example, this chapter will introduce the events in Fmod and configs for the game. 以语音包为例，本章将讲解 Fmod 中的事件以及游戏的音频配置。 1. Import Assets 导入资源 Create a subfolder in the crew folder, and drag your voice assets into this folder. 在 crew 文件夹下创建一个子文件夹，然后将音频文件拖入该文件夹。 2. Create Events 创建事件 Create a subfolder in crew/ground. Select a set of existing voice events. Press Ctrl + D to duplicate it and drag it into the newly created subfolder. Change the suffix from cn to whatever you want. 在 crew/ground 下创建一个子文件夹，选中一组现有的语音事件，按 Ctrl + D 复制并将其拖入刚刚创建的子文件夹。将事件后缀从 cn 更改为你想要的标识。例如，如图中所示，将 cn 改为 jp。 Select your event. Delete the original sounds from the playlist and add your sounds into the playlist one by one. 选中该事件，将 Playlist 中的原有音频删除，然后逐一将你的音频拖入其中。 3. Check Mixer 检查 Mixer Press Ctrl + 2 to enter the Mixer window. Be sure the newly created events are under the dialogs group. 按 Ctrl + 2 进入 Mixer 窗口，确保新创建的事件位于 dialogs 组中。 4. Create Sound Bank 创建 SoundBank Create a new bank under Banks. 在 Banks 中创建一个新的 Bank。 Then build all platforms. It will generate bank files at PanzerWar-Mods\PanzerWar-FMod-UGC-Project\Build. 然后，打包所有平台。Bank 文件将在 PanzerWar-Mods\PanzerWar-FMod-UGC-Project\Build 目录下生成。 Then the work in Fmod Studio is finished. Let's go back to the Unity project. 至此，Fmod Studio 中的工作已完成。让我们回到 Unity 工程。 5. Create Config 创建配置 Use the following tool to create configs faster. 使用以下工具快速创建配置。 5.1 Create Crew Voice Config 创建成员语音配置 Select the events that you created in Fmod in the previous step. 将上一步在 Fmod 中创建的事件名称填入对应类型。 5.2 Create Bank BuildPipline 创建 Bank 打包配置 Create the SoundBankBuildPiplineData Build file. 创建音效打包文件（SoundBankBuildPiplineData）。 Pick the folder that banks are built. 选择 Bank 文件所在的文件夹。 Pick .bank extension files. 选择 .bank 扩展名的文件。 In the configs array, sound bank configs are generated automatically. 在配置数组中，SoundBank Config 会自动生成。 6. Build Config 打包配置 Then, you can build like other Mods. 然后，即可像其他模组一样进行打包。

manual/mod/vrm-model.html.summary: 42.1. VRM Model VRM 模型 VRM Simply drag the VRM file into Unity. 将 VRM 格式的文件拖入 Unity 即可完成导入。 Adjusted VRM bone reference points VRM 骨骼参考点修正 If the VRM model was not created by yourself, you need to correct the bone reference points; otherwise, the physics behavior will be incorrect! 如果不是自己制作的 VRM 模型，则需要修正骨骼的参考点，否则物理表现会错误！ Select VRM Tool 选择 VRM 工具 Select the root node of the character in the scene, then click VRM1 / Export VRM 1.0... from the top menu bar. 选中场景中人物的根节点，点击顶部菜单栏的 VRM1 / Export VRM 1.0...。 Fill in the author and name, then click Export to overwrite the original VRM model. 填写作者和名称，点击导出以覆盖原本的 VRM 模型。 VRM Data Vrm Model Path: Please select a file ending with the .vrm format. Note: Only the original VRM model will be included in the build. Any modifications made to the VRM model within Unity will not take effect! Vrm Model Path：请选择以 .vrm 格式结尾的文件。 注意：打包时只会包含原始的 VRM 模型，在 Unity 中对 VRM 模型进行的任何修改都不会生效！ In CrewData, fill in the vrm guid. 在 CrewData 中，填写 VRM 的 Guid。 2.16 Hatch Compatible - 载具舱盖适配

"${fixture}/Tutorial_SharedGun.asset" }, "calls": [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": "static:UnityEditor.AssetDatabase/CreateFolder", "args": [ "${fixtureParent}", "${folder}" ] }, "expect": { "regex": "\\(String\\) [a-f0-9]{32}" } } ] } 本教程用 ZoomProfileData 资产为载具设置双目与瞄准镜的缩放倍率范围。所有字段名保持源代码中的原始拼写。 1. 创建 ZoomProfileData 资产 在 Project 窗口选择 Create > A Panzer War - 装甲纷争 > G Ground Vehicle - 地面载具 > Base - 载具配置 > Zoom - 倍率，创建 ZoomProfileData 资产。展开 倍率名称（zoomName），把默认名称填为 Tutorial Zoom。 本例使用独立教学资产，不修改现有载具配置。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "invoke", "arguments": { "path": maxRatio；这是作者约束，代码没有在此处校验。教程示例采用 minRatio = 2、maxRatio = 8，分别设置低倍与高倍端点。 运行时会读取这两个值来得出可用的倍率范围：BaseVehiclePawn.GetZoomRatio 对双目读取 binocularZoomProfileData 的 minRatio 与 maxRatio，对瞄准镜读取 zoomProfileData 的同样字段；资产为空时会退回到内置的默认区间。VehicleCameraZoom 随后按倍率换算水平视场角，并在区间内做插值。 点击展开 MCP 操作点击收起 MCP 操作 [ { "tool": "inspect_set", "arguments": { "path": "asset:${asset}/minRatio", "value": "2" }, "expect": { manual/workshop/glb-model-import-specs.h.title: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/glb-model-import-specs.h.summary: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 The tutorial process uses Blender modeling software, and the steps can be referred to for other modeling software as well. Blender can be downloaded for free on Steam. 本教程流程基于 Blender 建模软件，其他建模软件亦可参考本教程中的规范。Blender 可在 Steam 上免费下载。 Prepare Visual Model 准备外观模型 If using Blender, please refer to the following documentation. For the PBR workflow, follow the PBR rules outlined in the documentation to create the following textures: 1. Base Color, 2. Metallic and Roughness, 3. Baked Ambient Occlusion, and 4. Normal Map. Other textures mentioned in the documentation are not required. You can use Substance Painter to create the necessary textures. If not following the PBR workflow, you need to create 1. Base Color (mandatory) and 2. Normal Map (optional). However, the model will not achieve realistic physical reflections. 若使用 Blender，请参考以下文档。 若采用 PBR 流程，需遵循文档中的 PBR 规则，制作以下贴图：1. 基础色，2. 金属度与粗糙度，3. 烘焙的环境光遮蔽，以及 4. 法线贴图。文档中提及的其他贴图无需制作。可使用 Substance Painter 制作相应贴图。 若未采用 PBR 流程，则需制作 1. 基础色（必选）和 2. 法线贴图（可选）。但模型将无法呈现真实的物理反光效果。 glTF 2.0 - Blender 4.3 Manual （中文用户点击此链接打开文档：https://docs.blender.org/manual/zh-hans/4.3/addons/import_export/scene_gltf2.html） Preview the effect of the completed model in Blender. 在 Blender 中预览制作完成后的模型效果。 Additionally, you need to use LOD tools to create corresponding low-polygon models for displaying objects at a distance, reducing rendering performance pressure. You can choose to use the InstaLOD Blender plugin to automatically create LODs: 此外，需使用 LOD 工具制作对应的低多边形模型，用于物体在远处的显示，以降低渲染性能压力。可选择使用 InstaLOD Blender 插件自动创建 LOD： Follow the InstaLOD for Blender official installation guide to sign in to License Management, then download the latest plugin and the InstaLOD Pipeline from Your Files. 请按照 InstaLOD for Blender 官方安装文档登录 License Management，并从 Your Files 下载最新插件和 InstaLOD Pipeline。 Or use InstaLOD Studio: follow the InstaLOD Studio official installation guide to download and install the standalone version. 或者按照 InstaLOD Studio 官方安装文档下载并安装独立版。 If you do not use InstaLOD, you can also create low-polygon LODs manually with Blender's built-in Decimate Modifier. 不使用 InstaLOD 时，也可使用 Blender 内置的 Decimate Modifier手动制作低面数 LOD。 Child-Parent 父子关系 Rule 放置规则 Create four empty objects (Shift + A and select Empty - Plain Axes) and name them Visual, Collider, HitBox, and Module respectively. Note that the size and spelling must be exactly the same. Visual is used for placing the appearance model and LOD, Collider is used for placing non-concave collision models, HitBox is used for placing external armor, and Module is used for placing internal armor. 创建四个空物体（Shift + A 选择 Empty - Plain Axes），并分别命名为 Visual、Collider、HitBox 与 Module。注意，大小与拼写必须保持完全一致。Visual 用于放置外观模型与 LOD，Collider 用于放置非凹碰撞模型，HitBox 用于放置外部装甲，Module 用于放置内部装甲。 Completed State 制作完成后状态 After completing the various models, place them according to the rules in section 2.1. The specifications for creating damage models and internal structure models will be introduced in sections 3 and 4. (If this module is an object that can be hit by shells, these two models must be created.) The Collider collision model only needs to be created when making the vehicle hull model. 在制作完成各类模型后，按照 2.1 节的规则放置各类模型。 伤害模型与内构模型的制作规范将在第 3、4 节中介绍。（若此模块是可被炮弹击中的物体，则必须制作这两个模型。） 仅在制作车体模型时，才需要创建 Collider 碰撞模型。 LOD 特殊处理 Make the LOD models child objects of the unoptimized model and name them OriginalObjectName_LODNumber (starting from 1, up to a maximum of 3 LOD levels). **The name of the unoptimized original model must end with LOD0. ** 将 LOD 模型设为未优化模型的子物体，并命名为 原始物体名称_LOD序号（序号从 1 开始，至多可制作 3 层 LOD）。未优化的原始模型名称必须以 LOD0 结尾。 LOD 模型 HitBox 外部装甲 Reduced-polygon versions of the visual model. Models with different armor thicknesses need to be separated and then set their armor type and armor thickness according to the naming conventions in section 5. 外观模型的减面版本。不同装甲厚度的模型需分离，然后根据第 5 节的命名规范设置其装甲类型与装甲厚度。 Internal Module 内构模型 Lower-polygon internal module models are used for post-penetration shell damage. Then, set their type, armor thickness, and health according to the naming conventions in section 5. 较低面数的内部模块模型，用于炮弹穿透后的伤害。随后，根据第 5 节的命名规范设置其类型、装甲厚度与血量。 Collider 碰撞模型 A collision model only needs to be created for the vehicle hull model. 仅当制作车体模型时，才需要创建碰撞模型。 Naming 命名规范 2.12 HitBox Naming 伤害模型命名规范 Export 导出 Select the model you want to export, then click on glTF 2.0, choose the .glb format, check Selected Objects, and click Export. 选中要导出的模型，点击 glTF 2.0，选择 .glb 格式，勾选 Selected Objects，然后点击 Export。 Using Model 使用模型 Use Model Importer 使用模型导入工具 Windows Platform 电脑平台 Android Platform 安卓平台 Click on the glb format file and select Panzer War: Definitive Edition as the opening application. Enter the Tank Workshop, choose Model Import, and enter your glb file name (including the file extension). 点击 glb 格式文件，选择 装甲纷争：决定版 作为打开方式。进入坦克工坊，选择 模型导入，输入 glb 文件名（包含后缀）。

manual/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.title: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/gun-tutorial.html.summary: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 Custom Reload Type 自定义装填类型 Simple 简单 Traditional single-shot shells only require setting the reload time. 传统的单发炮弹，仅需设置装填时间。 Advanced 高级 For multi-shot magazine guns, you need to set the small reload time, the large reload time, and the magazine size. 多发弹夹炮需要设置小装填时间、大装填时间以及弹夹容量。 If the magazine size is too large, you can hide the icon to avoid a cluttered UI. 如果弹夹容量过大，可以隐藏图标，以避免 UI 过于拥挤。 Drum 弹鼓 Invented by the Italians, the drum mechanism is an optimized type of magazine gun that allows you to fire while loading backup rounds. You need to set the reload time for each backup round and the minimum firing interval of the drum. 由意大利人发明的弹鼓机制，是弹夹炮的一种优化类型，允许在装载备弹的同时开火。需要设置每发备弹的装填时间以及弹鼓的最小射击间隔。 Import Default Bullet 导入现有炮弹 You can modify the specific parameters of the default shells by importing the default shells. 你可以通过导入默认炮弹来修改其具体参数。 If you wish to fully customize your shells, you can also directly add different types of shells using the add button above. 如果你希望完全自定义炮弹，也可以直接通过上方的添加按钮，添加不同类型的炮弹。 The shell data will display the basic parameters of the shell, along with some specialized parameters in modular mode. 炮弹数据将显示炮弹的基本参数，以及模块模式下的部分专用参数。 In the debugging information of the shell, you can see the calculated data. If you modify the parameters of the shell, you need to click the recalculate button. 在炮弹的调试信息中，你可以查看计算后的数据。若修改了炮弹参数，需点击重新计算按钮。 Demarre Formula 德马尔公式 In our game, the penetration mechanics are based on the De Marre formula, which is used to estimate the penetration of a shell against armor. Here is an explanation of the formula and its parameters. 在我们的游戏中，穿甲机制基于德马尔公式，用于估算炮弹对装甲的穿透能力。以下是公式及其参数的解释。 \(\text{Penetration 穿深} = \left( \frac{m \cdot v_{\text{rel}}^2}{d^3 \cdot D_{\text{term}}} \right)^{\frac{1}{C_{\text{armor}}}} \cdot d \cdot K_{\text{nap}} \cdot 100\) \(m\) is the shell mass (kg) 是炮弹的质量（千克）； \(v_{\text{rel}}\) is the shell velocity component in the direction of the plate, calculated as: 是炮弹沿装甲板方向的速度分量，计算如下： \(v_{\text{rel}} = v_d \cdot \cos(\theta \cdot 0.85 \cdot C_{\text{angle}})\) \(v_d = v_0 \left( 1 - \frac{\lambda d}{v_0} \right)\) where \(C_{\text{angle}}\) is the penetration vs angle coefficient, \(\lambda\) is the drag, and \(v_0\) is the initial velocity; 其中 \(C_{\text{angle}}\) 是斜穿系数，\(\lambda\) 是阻力，\(v_0\) 是炮弹初速度； \(d\) is the shell diameter (m) 是炮弹直径（单位：米）； \(D_{\text{term}}\) is the De Marre term, calculated as: 是德马尔项，计算如下： \(D_{\text{term}} = \left( D_{\text{const}} \right)^2 \cdot d^{-0.1}\) where \(D_{\text{const}}\) is the De Marre constant; 其中 \(D_{\text{const}}\) 是德马尔常数； \(C_{\text{armor}}\) is the armor material coefficient 是装甲材料系数； \(K_{\text{nap}}\) is the adjustment factor based on the TNT ratio, calculated as follows: 是基于 TNT 比例的调整系数，计算如下： $ K_{\text{nap}} = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 0.65 \ 1 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 0.65 \right) \cdot (0.93 - 1)}{1.6 - 0.65} & \text{if } 0.65 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 1.6 \ 0.93 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 1.6 \right) \cdot (0.9 - 0.93)}{2 - 1.6} & \text{if } 1.6 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 2 \ 0.9 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 2 \right) \cdot (0.85 - 0.9)}{3 - 2} & \text{if } 2 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 3 \ 0.85 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 3 \right) \cdot (0.75 - 0.85)}{4 - 3} & \text{if } 3 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 4 \ 0.75 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} \geq 4 \end{cases} $ This formula combines all the terms to calculate the penetration of the shell against armor, taking into account the mass, velocity, diameter, material properties, impact angle, and explosive charge of the shell. 该公式结合所有参数来计算炮弹对装甲的穿透力，考虑了炮弹的质量、速度、直径、材料特性、入射角度和装药量。

manual/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.title: 1. Poly Edit 建模工具 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/poly-edit-tool.html.summary: 1. Poly Edit 建模工具 Use Editable Poly 使用可编辑多边形 In the Item tab, search for Editable, then install it onto the vehicle. Click the Edit Polygons button to enter edit mode. 在 Item 标签页中搜索 Editable，然后将其安装到载具上。点击 Edit Polygons 按钮，即可进入编辑模式。 Basic Options 基础选项 Face 面 In the right-side inspector window, select the Face, choose the faces on the model, and then click Move. Drag the arrow to edit the position of the face. Similarly, you can rotate the face orientation and use the Scale tool to modify the size of the face. 在右侧检查器窗口中选择面工具，选中模型上的面，然后点击 Move。拖动箭头即可编辑面的位置。同理，可以旋转面的朝向，并使用 Scale 工具修改面的大小。 Edge 边 Vertex 顶点 Operations 操作 Extrude 挤出功能 One of the most commonly used operations is used to extend a face. Select any face, then click the Extrude button. The face will move in its normal direction and extend out multiple new faces (as shown in the yellow area in the second image). 最常用的操作之一，用于扩展面。选中任意一个面，然后点击 Extrude 按钮，面会沿其法线方向移动，并扩展出多个新的面（如第二张图中的黄色区域所示）。 Bevel 倒角功能 Bevel is used to create chamfers on the edges or vertices of a model. In the image below, the red marked area shows the generated bevel. Bevel 用于在模型的边缘或顶点处创建倒角。下图中红色标记区域即为生成的倒角。 This document is still under construction, please check back later. This feature is currently in development. Future support will include: Importing obj files Models as external armor models Models as internal structures The full modeling tool functionality will be released in a future update. 本文档仍在建设中，请稍后查看。此功能目前仍处于开发阶段。 后续将支持： 导入 obj 文件 模型作为 HitBox 模型作为内部结构 完整的建模工具功能将在后续更新中发布。

manual/workshop/track-editor-tutorial.ht.summary: 4. Track Tutorial 履带编辑器 Dedicated Equipment 专用配件 You can find procedural track at the start. 你可以在列表开头找到程序化履带。 Attention 注意事项 Collision Setup 设置碰撞 Configure objects with collision in their slots to ensure the vehicle can move properly. Different types of colliders can affect the vehicle's physics in various ways. 在其插槽中配置带有碰撞的物体，以确保载具能够正常移动。不同类型的碰撞体会以不同方式影响载具的物理效果。 Pick Editable Poly 选择可编辑多边形 Enable its collider 启用其碰撞 Adjust center of gravity 调整重心 When creating your custom tank, adjusting the center of gravity is an important step to ensure your tank handles well. A higher center of gravity can cause the tank to tip over easily when turning or driving on uneven terrain, making it hard to control. By lowering the center of gravity or positioning it correctly, you can make your tank more stable and easier to handle, even in tough conditions. Make sure to experiment with different settings to find the perfect balance for your design! 在创建自定义坦克时，调整重心是确保坦克操控良好的关键步骤。重心过高会导致坦克在转弯或行驶于不平坦地形时容易倾翻，难以控制。通过降低重心或正确定位重心，可以使坦克更加稳定且易于操控，即使在复杂环境中也能轻松驾驭。请尝试不同的设置，以找到适合你设计的最佳平衡！
